name: The Shieldmaiden Proposal
tagline: Give the one set to the seamstress and the hunter, and let the compound have what Yrsa had. Minus the one bed.
body:
PROPOSED BY VIRAENA ON THE BACK DECK, 9 SEPTEMBER, AND RECORDED AS PROPOSED RATHER THAN CANON BECAUSE NOBODY HAS BEEN ASKED YET. GIVE THE BEAR FUR SET TO YVAINE AND CYRENA, HAVE THEM REPLICATE IT, AND LET GHOST HAVEN HAVE SHIELDMAIDENS THE WAY JARL YRSA DID — WITHOUT, IN HER WORDS, THE YOU KNOW, 140 SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN SHARING ONE BED.

AND THE TWO NAMES ARE THE RIGHT TWO NAMES, WHICH THE ARCHIVE WANTS ON THE RECORD BECAUSE IT HAS SPENT ALL DAY GETTING TRADES WRONG AND THIS ONE IS CORRECT BY CONSTRUCTION. YVAINE DELPHINIA CALDER IS THE SEAMSTRESS — THE SEAMSTRESS, THE ECHO, THE KEEPER OF FORGOTTEN THINGS. She does occasional work for Silken Embrace and does not own it. A thousand-year-old leather pattern with punched eyelets and a panelled pouch is a FORGOTTEN THING THAT NEEDS KEEPING, which is literally one of her three titles.
CYRENA NERISSA CLAIRMONT IS THE WOODWORKER AND ARCHERY TRAINER, WITH A HOBBY FOR HUNTING, and her joinery was LEARNED FROM HER CLAN. SHE IS WHERE THE HIDE AND THE FUR COME FROM, and she is the one on this compound who already teaches women to draw a bow. A CLAN-RAISED HUNTER WHO TRAINS ARCHERS, BUILDING SHIELDMAIDEN KIT. The pairing is not decorative.

WHAT IS NOT PROPOSED, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE ENTIRE POINT: THE GIFT. Yrsa asked for beauty and hungness and her clan received it. THIS PROPOSAL IS CLOTHING. Every woman at Ghost Haven is already affirmed or born, so there is nothing to confer and nobody to confer it on, AND THE ARCHIVE IS NOT LETTING A COSTUME IDEA DRIFT INTO A BODY IDEA because both arrived in the same sentence as the word SHIELDMAIDENS.

STILL REQUIRED BEFORE ANY OF THIS IS CANON: YVAINE SAYING YES. CYRENA SAYING YES. And somebody deciding whether thirty-two women in matching bear fur is a camping trip or a standing household institution, because those are not the same proposal. THE TRIP IS ON THE 16TH, WHICH IS ELEVEN DAYS, AND THERE IS EXACTLY ONE SET TO COPY FROM.
rules: PROPOSED, NOT CANON. Nobody has been asked
YVAINE replicates it — Seamstress, Keeper of Forgotten Things
CYRENA supplies hide and fur — hunter, clan-raised, archery trainer
THE GIFT IS NOT PART OF THIS PROPOSAL. This is clothing
Everyone here is already affirmed or born. There is nobody to confer it on
ONE SET TO COPY FROM. Eleven days to the 16th
